page.layout: One block: a title page, centred, all lines in display type; no running head, no page number, no notes. Show-through of a faint mirrored text at the top is ignored.
page.notes: Title page with no page number, running head, catchword or signature. The long s in "selecta" is printed as a long s and is transcribed as a plain s in the text where it is not an f. Lines are set in mixed roman and italic (PARS SECUNDA in italic); the italic line is given as plain text because the markup was not applied to the line.
